records.title: 10-K
records.text: Applebee’s domestic same-restaurant sales decreased 17.6% for the three months ended December 31, 2020 from the same period in 2019.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The decrease primarily was due to a significant decline in customer traffic as a result of the effects of COVID-19, partially offset by an increase in average check.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The June 15, 2020 issue of Nation's Restaurant News reported that IHOP and Applebee's were the largest restaurant systems in the family dining and casual dining categories, respectively, in terms of United States system-wide sales during 2019.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Our General & Administrative (“G&A”) expenses for the year ended December 31, 2020 were $18.0 million lower than the prior year.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Revenues and cash flows of our franchise, company-operated restaurant and rental operations were significantly affected by the varying degrees of limitations imposed on restaurant operations throughout the majority of 2020.
